title: A production backend refuses a public trustProxy range
why: Trusting a public range lets a visitor choose their own address. `brain check` and `brain doctor` warn B0784, a production `brain backend serve` refuses it, and `trustPublicProxy` declares a CDN.
steps: List only your own proxies in `trustProxy` in `server/platform.jsbrain`.
Move a CDN to `trustPublicProxy` with its published ranges.
Behind a proxy with no `trustProxy`, add it: `trustProxy: ['127.0.0.1', '::1']`.
